skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Identify accounts, descriptions, and related bases of evidence in cycles.
Assess potential risks and fraud risks affecting material misstatements in cycles.
Evaluate control risks affecting material misstatements in cycles.
Apply analytical procedures to identify potential material misstatements in cycles, descriptions, and related bases of evidence.
Develop appropriate audit procedures based on identified risks for testing transactional bases of evidence and account balances in cycles.
Collect evidence on accounts, transactions, and descriptions with related bases of evidence in cycles.

Collect residual evidence on discovered errors, potential liabilities, appropriateness of descriptions, non-compliance with laws and regulations, analytical review procedures, subsequent events, and continuous operation assumptions.
Apply comprehensive auditing knowledge to solve auditing problems arising during cycle audits in financial statement auditing processes.

Apply comprehensive knowledge of management, risk management, and controls to address audit findings and improve related processes of the audited entity, particularly controls over financial reporting.
Identify advantages and disadvantages when applying audit standards to specific cycle auditing processes in financial statement auditing of clients.
Evaluate residual risks after controls affect the cycles being audited.
Evaluate material misstatement risk with items in specific cycles being audited.

Integrate techniques to design test procedures for control activities and detailed transaction tests, detailed analytical procedures, and detailed balance tests according to material misstatement risks.
Execute audit tests in cycle audits and in evidence collection.
Process results of executed tests in cycle audits.
Combine evidence with consideration and execute further evidence collection procedures to complete financial statement auditing.
Present information on working papers for the purpose of accumulating evidence and forming audit opinions.
Combine obtained information/evidence to determine content and conclusions to be presented in reports according to Vietnamese Audit Standards.
Combine methods to communicate information about the results of performing audit segments through financial statement audit reports and management letters, ensuring compliance and effectiveness.
Comply with laws, relevant regulations, and ethical standards as well as specific guidelines for auditing segments in the performance of financial statement audit contracts for clients.
